title: Executable-wiring must ignore gitignored nested worktrees and scan only canonical repository files

sha_binding.verified_source_note: Substantive implementation commit. Post-merge closeout automation rebinds this field to the authoritative merge SHA.

verifier.independence_note: Executor-produced mechanical evidence; this is not PM approval or independent certification.

focused_tests.detail: Includes five UTV2-1659 regressions for nested worktrees, tracked .claude documentation, ignored/untracked invariance, newly tracked debt enforcement, and clean-clone/worktree-heavy parity.

canonical_scan.detail: The same checkout previously reported 3,321 tests and 2,856 false new findings from nested local worktrees.

verify_static.detail: Environment validation, alignment, automation coverage, lint, type-check, build, aggregate tests, Smart Form verification, and command checks passed.

pnpm_verify.detail: All static checks passed; the final local test:live-db stage correctly refused the loopback target. T1 staging DB proof must be harvested from the governed PR CI environment.

runtime_proof.row_counts_note: This is genuine evidence extracted from the real, already-completed push-triggered CI run (griff843/Unit-Talk-v2 run 30719244269, job 'Writable DB proof (staging only)' id 91420127834), which ran directly on merge SHA 64ac40ab0593f67fe848fa61d8a006f09d6e6a8e -- the exact commit UTV2-1659's manifest binds to. Not re-run locally: pnpm test:db is gated to the staging-ci GitHub environment (UTV2-1630 isolation) and refuses to run against a local checkout's non-staging Supabase target (`ci:assert-staging` REFUSED locally with host=unparseable). The automated harvest path (ops:proof-generate --merge-sha) that would normally pull this evidence automatically hits a separate, newly-discovered bug (UTV2-1664: locateCiDbProofRun resolves runs via the PR's pre-merge head SHA, which only surfaces the pull_request-triggered run whose receipt embeds GitHub's ephemeral merge-preview commit SHA, not this push-triggered run's own exact-match receipt) -- this governed proof-repair path is the sanctioned way to add real evidence when automated harvest cannot. The CI job itself wrote and hashed its own receipt: '[ci:db-smoke] receipt written to .out/ci-db-proof-receipt.json (sha256=3ac03f27ca57bcce0bd589b5f3ee2feb9f39be13ceb895d0d5ccd618c85d9cd0)' and printed '[ci:db-smoke] DB smoke passed'.
